hitl_conditions: Autonomy applies to real-time operational adjustments (routes, schedules) because urban conditions change too fast for manual management; humans retain strategic and policy-level oversight, defining objectives, constraints and long-term targets, and use dashboards/simulations for proactive planning.
key_finding: Framework combining IoT data, XGBoost/MLP predictors, a digital twin and a cybernetic feedback loop for last-mile delivery; on real data from a UK logistics firm, delivery-quality prediction accuracy rose from 76.3% (AUC 0.45) to 85.0% with the feedback loop; operational decisions are autonomous, humans set objectives.

HITL evidence: Sect. 3.2.2 (final two paragraphs), Sect. 3.3.3, Sect. 2.6.2, Sect. 5.4. No page numbers visible in the HTML version.

quotes.text: The predictive outputs feed into a digital twin simulation, creating a virtual model that mirrors real-world urban logistics scenarios. The digital twin evaluates multiple scenarios and adjusts routes accordingly, ensuring adaptive and optimized freight movement.
quotes.section: 2.7 Integrating Systems and Cybernetic Theories for Smart City Logistics (Digital Twin and Cybernetic Feedback Loop component, Fig. 1)

quotes.text: To validate the proposed framework, a case study was conducted in collaboration with a large logistics enterprise based in Yorkshire, UK. The study utilized real-time operational data collected from the company’s IoT-enabled logistics infrastructure
quotes.section: 3.4 Case Study: Application in Smart City Logistics

quotes.text: The system utilizes this IoT dataset to apply advanced gradient boosting algorithms (XGBoost) and neural networks (MLPs). The model predicts future congestion, estimated delivery times, and optimal routing paths.
quotes.section: 2.7 Integrating Systems and Cybernetic Theories for Smart City Logistics (Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics Layer)

quotes.text: After the feedback mechanism is applied, the model’s ability to distinguish between correctly and incorrectly predicted delivery outcomes improves significantly, reflected in the 85.0% accuracy.
quotes.section: 4.3.1 ROC Curve for Predictive Model Performance

quotes.text: While core operational efficiency is achieved through this autonomous decision-making capability, human oversight at the strategic and policy-making levels remains necessary. Rather than managing real-time logistics adjustments, managers and policymakers engage with the system primarily to define objectives, constraints
For example, if the system detects a sudden increase in congestion in a specific urban corridor, alternative delivery routes are automatically suggested, ensuring that delays are minimized.
